header.subject: Letter of Deficiency for Extension of Approval 2027-28

deficiencies.what: Image was saved by editing software
deficiencies.reason: EXIF Software / XMP CreatorTool says 'Adobe Photoshop 25.0 (Macintosh)'. Possible alteration, needs human review.
deficiencies.to_submit: Submit documents that address this deficiency.

deficiencies.what: Embedded thumbnail differs from the picture
deficiencies.reason: The camera thumbnail stored inside the file does not match the main image (difference 18.7; above 6: a strong sign the picture was edited after it was taken). Possible alteration, needs human review.
deficiencies.to_submit: Submit documents that address this deficiency.

deficiencies.reason: Modified 2026-10-07, 5 days after it was taken (2026-10-02). Possible alteration, needs human review.
deficiencies.to_submit: Submit documents that address this deficiency.

deficiencies.what: JPEG tables typical of re-saving in software (weak signal)
deficiencies.reason: Quantisation tables are the standard libjpeg set at quality 90 (hash e2037f0a543b3594), typical of a re-save by editing or conversion software rather than a camera. Weak signal on its own. Possible alteration, needs human review.
deficiencies.to_submit: Submit documents that address this deficiency.

closing: You are requested to upload the rectified documents on the AICTE portal within the time given on the portal. You may appeal within 7 days of this letter being uploaded.
